mia: Heads-up: Drew's birthday next Tue. thinking confetti-free (clean desks) treat + a digital gift card. who can do a lunchtime 12:30 surprise? :confetti_ball:
harper: can do 12:30. i'll bring coffee and donuts (non-gluten options).
noah: i'll join. also vote: gift card to local lunch spot or bookstore?
drew: surprise alert (i am reading this but play along) haha :sweat_smile:
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: react to vote: :one: Lunch spot  :two: Bookstore  :three: Charitable donation in Drew's name
mia: also remote folks — want to record 15s shoutouts? we can play during the card signing. send by Mon 3pm.
remind-bot: Reminder set: "Drew shoutouts due" Mon 3pm.
harper: voted :one: Lunch spot.
noah: voted :two: Bookstore (Drew loves paperbacks)
drew: i'm touched either way. also can someone hide a tiny rubber duck on my desk? :duck: (joking but seriously)
people-ops-bot: Team budget covers up to $40. Collection link: https://pay.example.com/drew-bday for extras.
mia: final call: poll closes Sun 6pm. signing card at 12:25 in the kitchen. keep it hush hush.
drew: (again reading) oh wow you all are sneaky :eyes:
remind-bot: Event created: "Drew lunch surprise" Tue 12:30-13:00 (Kitchen + Zoom).
people-ops-bot: Note: Facilities approved no-confetti request.
mia: thanks team — appreciate the help. :heart: (End of thread)
